title: FLA import: motion tween sync flag (syncGraphic) not decoded from binary
description: flash8-binary.ts decodes many tween fields (keyMode, motionEase, motionRotate, motionOrientToPath) but not tweenSync/syncGraphic. flash8-import.ts also has no tweenSync in its createFrame call — the flag is silently dropped. The sync flag makes a graphic symbol synchronize its timeline to the parent frame. Fix: find and decode the sync flag from CPicFrame binary in flash8-binary.ts, add sync to the tween model, forward through flash8-import.ts.
